title: From Final Artifacts to Trajectories: Retrospective Process Supervision for Evidence-Grounded Long-Form Generation
abstract: arXiv:2608.30461v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Trajectory data is getting more vital for training large language models for boosting the agentic abilities. Unlike the verifiable domains such as coding or mathematics, scaling trajectory data for open-ended tasks is much more difficult because these tasks lack singular ground truth and are costly to annotate or verify. In this paper, we propose RetroGen, a self-improving framework of retrospective process supervision. Our key observation is that although expert trajectories are scarce, high-quality final artifacts such as literature reviews, analyst reports and legal judgments, are abundant in pre-training data and can be viewed as compressed traces of the evidence-seeking processes that produced them. RetroGen reconstructs candidate latent trajectories from expert artifacts, verifies them against both the artifact and supporting evidence, and trains models on their own successful reconstruction data, without requiring trajectory data

translated_title: 从最终产物到轨迹：面向证据支撑长文本生成的回溯式过程监督
translated_abstract: 轨迹数据对于训练大型语言模型、提升其智能体能力正变得越来越重要。与编程或数学等可验证领域不同，为开放式任务扩展轨迹数据要困难得多，因为这些任务缺乏唯一的真实标准，且标注或验证成本高昂。在本文中，我们提出了 RetroGen，一种回溯式过程监督的自改进框架。我们的关键观察是：尽管专家轨迹稀缺，但高质量的最终产物（如文献综述、分析师报告和法律判决）在预训练数据中十分丰富，并且可以被视为产生这些产物的证据搜寻过程的压缩痕迹。RetroGen 从专家产物中重建候选的潜在轨迹，对照产物本身和支撑证据对重建结果进行验证，并在模型自身成功的重建数据上进行训练，全程无需轨迹数据。
tldr: 该论文提出 RetroGen 框架，通过将预训练语料中丰富的高质量最终产物（如文献综述、分析师报告）逆向重建为证据搜寻轨迹，并结合产物与支撑证据进行验证筛选，从而在无需稀缺轨迹数据的情况下，实现开放式长文本生成的自改进过程监督训练。
en_tdlr: RetroGen retrospectively reconstructs and verifies latent evidence-seeking trajectories from abundant high-quality final artifacts in pre-training data, enabling self-improving process supervision for open-ended long-form generation without requiring scarce trajectory data.
